desc: Test with given examples: l=10,r=20 → 2; l=1,r=15 → 10
Verify edge cases: l=1,r=1 → 1; l=r=9 → 9 (all single digits are beautiful)
Test with a larger range (e.g., l=1, r=10^5) and compare with brute force to ensure accuracy
Ensure `prod_mod` initialization is correct (e.g., when `started=False` and we place first non-zero digit `d`, set `prod_mod = d % s`; when `d=0` and `started` becomes true, set `prod_mod = 0`)
Cache DP results across the loop over `s_val` by hoisting the `lru_cache` outside the loop and defining the DP function once that takes `s_val` as a parameter
Verify correctness with brute force for ranges up to 10^5 after caching optimization
Time the optimized solution on range [1, 10^9-1] to confirm it runs within acceptable time (e.g., < 5 seconds)
